description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace, specifically for configuring in-memory streaming support using memory streams within a silo. It includes methods to add memory stream providers with optional custom serializers.

classes.name: SiloBuilderMemoryStreamExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to facilitate configuration of in-memory streams in Orleans silos.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams
methods.description: Adds a memory stream provider with default message serializer to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams<TSerializer>
methods.description: Adds a memory stream provider with a specified message serializer type to the silo builder.
